definitions.accuracy: All 79 cases in each repetition, original unchanged oracle, new-to-old hash mapping; totals over 237 runs.
definitions.reported_api_equivalent_usd: Sum/mean of saved Claude Code result total_cost_usd. Not an actual subscription bill; no new price schedule applied.
definitions.audit_scope: Recheck frozen code/inputs, manifests, transcript/event/stderr/debug checksums, settings, stored capture-validation results, and score output. Captured entity bodies were verified at run finalization, not rehashed by this post-hoc script.
definitions.billing: Every run passed the subscription gate; additional usage disabled by prior user confirmation, not independently observable in CLI status.
definitions.interpretation: All messages including BFC bug/fix description removed; not a historical-messages-only ablation. No significance or causal mechanism inferred here.
definitions.total_seconds: Wall-clock finish minus start, as in RQ1: before launching the single-attempt child through return and outcome inspection. Includes per-attempt preparation, authentication checks, proxy setup, model/tools/communication, postflight and capture validation. Excludes initial dataset construction, queue/quota waiting and other attempts.
definitions.total_monotonic_seconds: Same outer interval measured with a monotonic clock; retained to detect wall-clock adjustments.
definitions.process_seconds: Exact run.json/process.duration_seconds; Claude Code process start through exit, including model/tools/communication, excluding outer preparation and validation.
definitions.bash_calls: Completed transcript-visible Bash tool-use events with matched results; one call can contain multiple shell commands. Tool-result errors are included.
definitions.repetition_mean_accuracy: Pool 79 cases within each repetition, then average the three repetition-level TP/FP/FN and P/R/F1 values. Overall also retains pooled 237-run accuracy.
definitions.historical_attempts: Excluded from primary accuracy, resource totals and means; preserved separately. No retry was initiated by this aggregation.

historical_attempts.reason: User-interrupted attempt; explicit manual restart retained as primary.
